I left PR 272 in draft and did not run `gh pr ready`, because the readiness gate isn't met: the only completeness verdict clears part of the plan, and the skill requires a clear verdict on the whole approved plan before a PR can be marked ready.

The deciding evidence is CodeRabbit's reply to the assessment request (comment 9502, for base/head `73d32981c7b7e8f52590a074873e28a9f369f0f9...ffff6666`, plan revision rev-7): *"Assessed subject: the declared subset (milestones EP-M1 and EP-M2 only); the whole approved plan is not cleared by this reply … This verdict covers that subset only and does not clear the whole approved plan."* The skill says such a verdict "is evidence for its actual scope only" and "the record never clears the gate", so I logged it as evidence for EP-M1 and EP-M2 only.
